name: DhanaERP Tenant Base
description: Tenant-specific application foundation for DhanaERP customer deployments on Frappe v16.

notes: Tenant-specific application bundle layered on top of dhana-base-v16.
Defines the DT Tenant application for DhanaERP customer deployments.
Framework and shared ERP applications are inherited through dhana-base-v16.
Optional capabilities are composed separately by individual product manifests.
DT Tenant and DT Master remain independent application families.
All applications must pass Frappe v16 compatibility validation before production locking.

applications.notes: DhanaERP Tenant application. Provides tenant-specific functionality for customer deployments.
